description: Default FDA review window lengths (days) by review program for decision_by_T when PDUFA is absent. Public-domain FDA calendar conventions; CNPV is empirical pilot length.
sourceNotes: Standard NDA/BLA: ~10 months from filing acceptance (~300 calendar days used as model prior).
CNPV (Commissioner's National Priority Voucher) pilot: ~1–2 months target; model uses 45 days until larger sample exists.
Unknown / missing program: 240 days (between priority and standard).
